sentences.text:
5. Office report dated 12.08.2024 states that the classification memo states that the restoration application is pending since long and the case has already been dismissed but the same is incorrect as the restoration application has already been allowed vide order dated 31.01.2017.
6.
Perusal of record shows that the office report regarding the restoration application is in consonance with record.
7. The matter is of the year 2014, there are chances of the matter being rendered infructuous by efflux of time.
8. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as infructuous.
9. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

10. Office to communicate this order to the trial court concerned within two weeks.
11.
If cause survives, the applicants will have liberty to file an appropriate application for reviving the matter.
